descriptive: user 2026-11-20 dialog, "Yes, upper tail only", re-read after the GELU departure. No reuse/new verdict is given; every lean below is a description checked against its filed range, and each reading is reported beside E217's at the same percentile.

readings.featurization: per MLP site, a neuron is a feature on a token when its post-GELU activation is above the neuron's upper percentile from the base on 400 Pile val rows (E217's saved file, reused: experiments/topk_neurons/results/large/percentiles.pt); every other activation at the site, GELU's negative floor included, is the one site remainder (commute.kstar.Feat with lo None). E217 used above p_hi or below p_lo.
readings.s_u, K*, R, f, site_remainder_share, ove: exactly E217's (experiments/topk_neurons/results/predictions.json 'readings'), through E217's own functions read_vars, overlap, w0 and control
readings.beside: each item and band: run 2's row and E217's row at the matching band (p97 with p97/3, p99 with p99/1, p90 with p90/10) and E217's width R_read; the width is not re-read in stage 1 (every activation a feature, so the featurization is the same as E217's)

expected.W0: F = M on control_item's windows at p97, p99, p90 and the width: no changed variable, every s_u = 1 within s_tol, gate 'all' and 'none' <= gate_tol, overlap = 1. A miss stops the job.
expected.pile_strong_share: share of base activations on the Pile rows above the band's percentile: 0.03, 0.01, 0.10 for p97, p99, p90, each within share_tol (relative 0.1) of 1 - q; E217 read its two-sided shares within 0.0008 relative, so a miss means the file or the upper-only path is broken
expected.read_strong_share: the same share on the read windows at W0, reported: about 0.025-0.035 at p97 (E217's two-sided p97/3 read 0.0577 against 0.06 on the Pile)
expected.control: at the width, per item, R over every part and over E208's five circuits (grade 'all') equal E213's within max(floor_factor x E217's measured floor 9.04e-9, floor_min) = 9.04e-8 (E217 passed it on all 20 at <= 7.9e-8), and every site remainder's s = 1; each item's R also printed beside E217's stage-0 control value (same code, same card class: expected equal to float rounding). A miss on any item stops the job before stage 1.
expected.gates: every item and band: gate 'all' <= gate_tol; a miss stops that task

P1.what: R_read on K* at p97 (upper only)
P1.lean: between 0.95 and 0.9995 on every trained fine-tune (E217's p97/3 read 0.9598-0.9896), and below the same item's E217 width R_read

P2.what: R_read at p97 minus E217's R_read at p97/3, per item
P2.lean: at or above 0 on every item: dropping GELU's floor tail removes threshold crossings that scored as disagreement; reported per item, the rivals split at 0.01

P3.lean: above E217's p97/3 overlap (0.231-0.361) on every item, between 0.25 and 0.95

P4.what: overlap at p97 minus E217's overlap at p97/3, per item
P4.lean: above 0 on every item; the rivals split at 0.1

P5.what: lowest site-remainder s at p97, grade read
P5.lean: between 0.8 and 1 on every item; no direction against E217's 0.832-0.942 (the remainder now also holds the floor tail, which sits near -0.17 in both networks)

P6.lean: all four remainders in every K*, share under 0.01 (E217 p97/3: 0.0006-0.0014)

P8.lean: within E217's span over all bands, 363-8259; reported beside E217's p97/3 2826-6270

P9.what: R_read, overlap and site_remainder_share at p99 and p90
P9.lean: reported beside E217's p99/1 and p90/10, no range: the sensitivity check (E217's p99/1 remainder share reached 0.011, and a smaller upper-only K* can push it higher)

P10.what: reuse-minus-twin gaps of R_read, counted pairs, each band
P10.lean: reported per seed with the seed difference and E217's gap beside it; no lean and no verdict (descriptive)

settings.settings_source: every key E217 has is E217's filed value (experiments/topk_neurons/results/predictions.json settings), so the windows, the search and the bars are E217's; bands: the upper quantiles of E217's p97/3, p99/1, p90/10 (user 2026-11-20 dialog: upper tail only, for the 67M's NewGELU); percentile_qs and percentiles_sha256: E217's saved percentile file (its stage0.json percentiles_sha256; q holds 0.9, 0.97, 0.99 in float32), reused rather than recomputed; share_tol: relative 0.1, over 100x E217's largest measured two-sided deviation (0.0008 relative, p99/1); the control bar's floor is E217's measured floor (stage0.json 'floor', 9.04e-9), not remeasured

stops: stage 0: percentile file sha or quantiles differ, pile_strong_share outside share_tol, a W0 miss, or a width-control miss -> exit 1, no stage 1. Stage 1: a gate miss -> exit 1 for that task.
